metadata.title: Branched real projective structures on surfaces, cyclic Higgs Bundles and Anosov representations
metadata.abstract: We use the theory of $3$-cyclic $\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb{R})$-Higgs bundles to study real branched projective structures on compact surfaces recently introduced by the authors. After fixing a Riemann surface structure on $S$, the Higgs bundle approach allows us, on the one hand, to construct branched structures with prescribed branching data and, on the other hand, to introduce new classes of such structures. The latter are directly related to singular hyperbolic affine spheres and carry a Blaschke metric with conical singularities. In the final part of the paper, using different methods, we prove that every Anosov surface group representation into $\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb{R})$ is either Hitchin or belongs to the Barbot component. As a by-product, we obtain that some of the representations associated with the branched structures constructed above are not Anosov.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 分支实射影结构、循环Higgs丛与Anosov表示
analysis.workSummary: 固定紧曲面的Riemann结构，用3-cyclic SL(3,R)-Higgs丛构造指定分支数据的实分支射影结构，并引入与奇异双曲仿射球相联、Blaschke度量有锥奇点的新类。另用不同方法证明每个到SL(3,R)的Anosov曲面群表示要么Hitchin，要么位于Barbot分支。
analysis.breakthrough: 连接分支结构与Higgs数据，并据Anosov分支二择性识别部分新构造的表示不是Anosov。
analysis.limitations: 摘要不声称所有指定分支数据都无条件可实现，也不能将分支二择性扩大到其他秩或目标群。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: PDF第6页GenAI declaration限定第二作者N.R.用未具名LLM检索SL(3,R) Anosov表示文献，并具体指向此前未知的[GW10]。全文与证明想法均由作者完成，明确否认LLM用于这些环节，故仅记literature；发现参考文献不等于模型提出核心证明思想。
